_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Fact Finding Report
summary: The Fact Finding Report captures relevant facts regarding an unplanned event and documents the severity level of associated problems.
use_relationship:
This DID will capture relevant facts regarding an unplanned event and will document the severity level of problems associated with the unplanned event.
This DID contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific requirement delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be in a format similar to that of Figures 1, 2 and 3.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall contain all of the information specified in Figures 1, 2 and 3 and shall contain the following information:

children.title: Working copy of cause and Corrective Action Form(s)
Any other document(s) used during the Fact Finding Investigation
The identity of the senior manager who performed the review
Complete chronological statement of relevant facts from the unplanned event
Any other document(s) used during the Fact Finding Investigation (e.g. Independent Statements from individual(s), appropriate references, technical work documents)
A copy of critique meeting attendance from if a critique meeting was held
Identity of any similar unplanned event(s)
